entities.name: Jakub Šindel
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jakub Šindel is a Czech former ice hockey center. During his career, which lasted from 2003 to 2016, he played for several teams in different European leagues. He was also selected by the Chicago Blackhawks of the National Hockey League in the 2nd round of the 2004 NHL Entry Draft. After his playing career he became a referee.
